## Slowed or blocked

- `watch-pr.sh`: re-armed it four times while waiting on review; each run died at the 2 h headless background-command cap and the turn ended with nothing armed.
- `npx bats` took about four minutes per full run, so each review round paid that twice.

## Skill wrong or missing

- `git-workflow` step 7 says to run `/code-review`, but no such tool exists in a subagent. The skill says "where the harness has no code-review tool, the standards pass is the whole stage", which I only found on a second read.

## Worked around

- Re-armed `watch-pr.sh` by hand from its last `── re-arm ──` line after every cap.

## Wished to ask

Nothing.
